line: Bring a treat to share with the people around you.
paragraph: Gloria Kennard has cooked Thanksgiving dinners for her Texas community for 37 years. Every year, she prepares meals for 2,000 people. As she began preparing for this year's holiday, the town began raising money for her. Neighbors raised over $27,000 to buy Miss Gloria a new car. She said, "Thank you so very much."
